title: [C] Custom Carrots
description: adds 13 new types of carrots to Minecraft, each with its own unique power and custom texture.
body:
![custom-carrots](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f23069fd5e4bd2eee1e2ad1f321e60b48d760d27.png)
┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈・ ✦ ・┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈
**Custom Carrots adds 13 new types of carrots** to Minecraft, each with its own unique ability and custom texture. The additions are designed to blend naturally into the vanilla game while still offering a fresh and distinct experience.

Each carrot provides a slightly different effect, adding variety to gameplay without significantly altering core mechanics.

This datapack is well-suited for **content creators**, as well as players looking to add something new and interesting to their survival worlds.

**Custom Carrots is part of the Challenge Series**

┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈・ ✦ ・┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈
 ## Carrot Abilities & Recipes

**1. Farming Carrot**

![farming-carrot-recipe](https://i.postimg.cc/y6hT7ym6/farming.png)


<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

- After eating this carrot, sneaking will cause carrots to rain down for the next 30 seconds.

</details>

┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈・ ✦ ・┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈

**2. Coal Carrot**

![coal-carrot-recipe](https://i.postimg.cc/L6KLgYVC/coal.png)


<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

- This carrot grants Night Vision for 5 minutes.
- Gives an OP pickaxe. When you mine iron ore with it, it drops ingots instead of raw iron. The pickaxe only lasts for 5 minutes.

</details>

┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈・ ✦ ・┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈

**3. Copper Carrot**

![copper-carrot-recipe](https://i.postimg.cc/d17vF0kr/copoer.png)


<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

- Gives you an OP sword that can almost one-shot most mobs in the game, except the Ender Dragon.
- Gives you a Riptide-enchanted trident. While holding it in your main hand, a thunderstorm starts, allowing you to use it.

</details>

┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈・ ✦ ・┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈

**4. Iron Carrot**

![iron-carrot-recipe](https://i.postimg.cc/TwyQfKVV/iron.png)


<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

- Gives you a custom crossbow that shoots explosive arrows and covers the surface with iron blocks.
- Gives you custom boots that completely remove fall damage.

</details>

┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈・ ✦ ・┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈

**5. Gold Carrot**

![gold-carrot-recipe](https://i.postimg.cc/4yyGJb88/gold.png)


<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

- Gives you a heart-shaped food item that adds an extra row of hearts for a short time.

</details>

┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈・ ✦ ・┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈

**6. Diamond Carrot**

![diamond-carrot-recipe](https://i.postimg.cc/0jR44YTM/diamond.png)


<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

- Summons a pack of wolves equipped with maxed-out armor that will protect you from enemies.

</details>

┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈・ ✦ ・┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈

**7. Netherite Carrot**

![netherite-carrot-recipe](https://i.postimg.cc/KvsPvGYQ/netherite.png)


<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

- Gives you a full set of OP diamond armor. (Wait what diamond armor? yea cuz we r messing around)

</details>

┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈・ ✦ ・┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈

**8. Dark Carrot**

![dark-carrot-recipe](https://i.postimg.cc/k4pJRptr/dark.png)


<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

- Gives you an overpowered scythe that can almost one-shot most mobs, launching them into the air until they die.

</details>

┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈・ ✦ ・┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈

**9. Amethyst Carrot**

![amethyst-carrot-recipe](https://i.postimg.cc/90C6MPL3/amethyst.png)


<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

- Gives you a strange bow called the Banish Bow that banishes any mob it hits

</details>

┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈・ ✦ ・┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈

**10. Wind Carrot**

![wind-carrot-recipe](https://i.postimg.cc/NMJ69B4g/wind.png)


<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

- Gives you a custom charge that lets you dash. Hold it in either hand and sprint to activate the dash.

</details>

┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈・ ✦ ・┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈

**11. Lava Carrot**

![lava-carrot-recipe](https://i.postimg.cc/N0P8LQbQ/lava.png)


<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

- Gives you a custom item called the Lava Relic. Hold it in your main hand to activate it, allowing you to split lava lakes and create a path through them.

</details>

┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈・ ✦ ・┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈

**12. Ice Carrot**

![ice-carrot-recipe](https://i.postimg.cc/g2x2mdwV/ice.png)


<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

- Gives you an Ice Relic. Works the same as the Lava Relic, but it splits water when held in your main hand.

</details>

┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈・ ✦ ・┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈

**13. Emerald Carrot**

![emerald-carrot-recipe](https://i.postimg.cc/wxFNBqBZ/emerald.png)


<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

- Summons a custom trading villager.
- Gives you a custom goat horn that can teleport that villager to your location whenever you use it.

</details>

┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈・ ✦ ・┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈
